file_descriptions.Dialogues.ecf: The textual content is localized in `Extras/Localization.csv` and `Content/Configuration/Dialogues.csv` (key = dialogue/node name).
file_descriptions.EClassConfig.ecf: Structure: `{ Entity Name: Zirax` (+ sub-blocks `{ Child 0 ... }` for sensors/behaviors). Main keys:
file_descriptions.EGroupsConfig.ecf: Group names (Crawler, ZiraxMale, TalonGuardianGroup...) are referenced by CreatureSpawning/SpawnZones/EClass.
file_descriptions.ItemsConfig.ecf: Weapons: the class defines the damage model. - `Class: Ranged` → damage comes from the weapon; the ammo only carries mass/volume/cost. - `Class: LauncherSS` → damage AND BlastDamage come from the ammo (child block `Class: Projectile`); BlastDamage is added to the base for the CENTER block only.
file_descriptions.MaterialConfig.ecf: Note: the HumanSoft/CreatureSoft/Mechanical/DronePlanet/Player materials are declared NOWHERE (vanilla 37, RE2 86, ATL 55) — checking them = false positives.
file_descriptions.PDA.yaml: The execution model is `Eleon.PdaScript` (Chapters→Tasks→Actions, rewards, triggers) — Action/Chapter/Dialog/Task classes + specific actions: InventoryContains, InventoryOpened, ItemsPickedUp, NearPoi, NearResource, NearUnit, Signal, Timer, ToolbarContains, WaveAttack. Keys below are those observed in RE2-FR's PDA.yaml.
file_descriptions.Sectors.yaml: Read by the engine's galaxy loader; THIS is the file that places all playfields in 3D space.
file_descriptions.TraderNPCConfig.ecf: Trader definitions: goods, selling text and discounts.
file_descriptions.gameoptions.yaml: Engine model `GameOptionsYamlData.Dataset` — the descriptions below are a translation of Eleon's doc-strings (`[PackageHelper]`). The first dataset whose `ValidFor` matches the conditions (Survival/Creative/Freedom/Debug × SP/MP) is used; a dataset without `ValidFor` = universal default.
file_descriptions.playfield.yaml: Typed by the engine in `PlayfieldYamlData` (+ nested classes `InstanceData`, `LocalEffectData`, `GlobalEffectData`, `RandomResourceData`, `FixedResourceData`, `AsteroidResourceData`, `ResourceDistType*`, `PresetData`, `PoiData.*`, `DroneBaseSetupData.*`, `DroneSpawnData`, `CreatureSpawnData`, `SpawnZoneData`, `SpawnRateZoneData`, `TerrainBiomeData`, `DCClusterData`, `SpecialBiome`, `PoiData.PlayerStartData`). YAML key names = C# property names (reflection binding).
file_descriptions.terrain.ecf: Defines the terrain TEXTURE MATERIALS: each root block `{ Material Name: N TextureName }` = one main texture, and its `{ Child N # SubTextureName }` = the possible transitions/blends.
